Travel up to 50% across the assigned territory.Discover Impactful WorkAs a Field Application Scientist (FAS) (m/f/d) within the BioProduction Group, you will serve as a bioprocessing domain expert, helping biotechnology and biopharmaceutical customers accelerate technology adoption, process development, and optimization across downstream workflows.You will engage with customers on a peer-to-peer, application-focused basis, providing technical leadership and process expertise before, during, and after the sale. You will also play an important role in shaping future innovations by capturing and communicating Voice of Customer (VOC) insights.A Day in the Life:Serve as a technical expert and consultant, applying deep bioprocessing knowledge across purification, filtration, and single-use technologies. Engage with customers on a peer-to-peer basis to support process development, optimization, scale-up, and technology integration across downstream workflows.Lead pre- and post-sales technical activities, including product evaluations, proof-of-principle (PoP) studies, technology qualification, and implementation in regulated environments. Contribute to pre-sales activities by delivering technical presentations on the features, benefits, and applications of POROS™ and CaptureSelect™ products, addressing downstream purification challenges and positioning Thermo Fisher Scientific capabilities against customer requirements.What to expect:- Provide comprehensive technical troubleshooting and act as an initial point of contact for product quality and performance issues, partnering with Quality, Field Service, and Technical Support to ensure timely and compliant resolution.- Deliver technical training to internal and external audiences, including process scientists, engineers, and operators, to build capability and confidence in Thermo Fisher Scientific technologies and workflows.- Conduct workflow consultations and GEMBA walks at customer sites to identify process improvement opportunities and align technical solutions with operational and business objectives.- Support Bioprocessing Development Center (BDC) activities, customer trials, and on-site demonstrations, ensuring consistent technical messaging and execution excellence.- Develop and execute customer technology adoption plans with measurable milestones, followed by utilization reviews to assess implementation, performance, and opportunities for further optimization.- Document customer engagements and technical activities in Salesforce (SFDC), maintaining accurate records of activities, opportunities, win plans, technical risks, and mitigation actions.- Collaborate cross-functionally with Account Managers, Field Service Engineers, Technical Support, Product Management, R&D, and Quality/Regulatory teams to deliver seamless end-to-end customer outcomes.- Capture, synthesize, and communicate Voice of Customer (VOC) insights to support product roadmaps, feature development, and best-practice content, including application notes, white papers, and case studies.- Represent Thermo Fisher Scientific at industry conferences, workshops, webinars, and customer events, delivering workflow-based technical presentations and thought leadership.Keys to Success:Education- BS, MS, or PhD in Chemical Engineering, Biochemical Engineering, Bioengineering, Biotechnology, or a related scientific or engineering discipline, or equivalent relevant bioprocessing experience.Experience- 5+ years of hands-on bioprocessing experience, ideally within Process Development, with strong expertise in downstream processing.- Demonstrated experience with downstream purification technologies, including chromatography, UF/DF, centrifugation, and related unit operations.- Proven track record of technical engagement, process troubleshooting, and problem solving within Process Development and/or biomanufacturing environments.- Experience supporting process scale-up, technology transfer, and process optimization from development through pilot and manufacturing scale.- Hands-on experience with commonly used chromatography systems/skids at laboratory, pilot, and manufacturing scale, including the ability to operate systems and interpret data using commonly used chromatography software.- Practical experience with column packing at small, pilot, and/or manufacturing scale.Knowledge, Skills, Abilities- Deep understanding of bioprocessing and downstream purification workflows, with the ability to translate scientific and engineering principles into practical customer solutions.- Strong capability in process design, optimization, troubleshooting, and workflow consulting, using data-driven approaches to identify opportunities for improvement.- Familiarity with Process Analytical Technology (PAT), Design of Experiments (DoE), and Quality by Design (QbD) principles, including relevant ICH Q8, Q9, and Q10 concepts.- Knowledge of analytical methods used to support purification process development, including HPLC, ELISA, SDS-PAGE, and spectroscopy, with the ability to interpret and communicate analytical data.- Proficiency with data analysis tools such as Excel and JMP; experience with scripting or additional analytical tools is an advantage.- Strong technical writing, presentation, and communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with scientists, engineers, operators, and senior technical stakeholders.- Strong problem-solving and influencing skills, with demonstrated effectiveness in cross-functional and matrixed environments.- Experience using Salesforce.com (SFDC CRM) for customer engagement, opportunity, and activity tracking.- Fluent in German and English, with strong written and verbal communication skills in both languages.- Based in Germany or Austria, ideally in the Frankfurt area or northern Germany, with convenient access to a major airport or transportation hub to support frequent travel across the assigned territory.- Willing and able to travel up to 50%, primarily across Germany and, depending on home location, Austria.- Valid driver’s license and passport, with the ability to travel as required within the territory.Benefits:We offer competitive remuneration, annual incentive plan bonus, healthcare, and a range of employee benefits. jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description: A Snapshot of Your Day As a Government Affairs Manager at Siemens Energy, you will help shape the political, regulatory, and geopolitical environment in which we operate. You will translate policy developments into business opportunities, build trusted relationships with government stakeholders, and support Siemens Energy’s leadership in advancing the global energy transition.Working closely with Business Areas, regional leadership (Hubs), and Executive Board Members, you will identify emerging political trends, assess risks and opportunities, and develop advocacy strategies that support the company’s growth agenda. You will be the interlink to and representative for selected HUBs and the corporate Government Affairs department. Your work will directly contribute to creating favorable market conditions for energy infrastructure, decarbonization technologies, grid modernization, and energy security solutions. How You’ll Make an Impact * Monitoring and analysis of political, regulatory, and geopolitical developments* Advocacy, stakeholder engagement, and relationship management across key public and industry stakeholders* Political positioning and policy support aligned with Siemens Energy’s strategic priorities* Identification of policy-driven business opportunities, including incentives, industrial policy, and funding programs* Preparation of executive briefings, talking points, stakeholder dossiers, and strategic assessments* Cross-functional coordination and external representation to strengthen Siemens Energy’s positioning in the global energy transitionWhat You Bring* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Political Science, Public Policy, International Relations, Economics, Law, or a related field* Several years of professional experience in Government Affairs, Public Affairs, Public Policy, Regulatory Affairs, diplomacy, consulting, or related fields* Strong understanding of European and international energy policy, industrial policy, and geopolitical developments* Proven stakeholder management, analytical, strategic, and communication skills, including executive-level presentations and briefing materials* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced international environment, manage multiple priorities, and demonstrate high integrity and commitment to compliance* Fluent English and good German; additional languages advantageousAbout the TeamThe Government Affairs department supports Siemens Energy's mission to become the world's most valued energy technology company. We connect business priorities with public policy, identify geopolitical risks and opportunities, and work with governments and institutions to promote energy security, industrial competitiveness, and decarbonization. Our team combines policy expertise, stakeholder engagement, geopolitical analysis, and strategic advocacy to create business value and enable long-term growth across global markets.Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideoOur Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. Rewards/Benefits * In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbaticalWe value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs
